orders_marketplace_ref.name: orders_marketplace_ref
orders_marketplace_ref.value: "sales"."orders"."source" <> 'marketplace' or ("sales"."orders"."shop_id" is not null and "sales"."orders"."external_order_id" is not null)

accounts_totp_enabled_has_secret.name: accounts_totp_enabled_has_secret
accounts_totp_enabled_has_secret.value: "staff"."accounts"."totp_enabled_at" is null or "staff"."accounts"."totp_secret_enc" is not null

invitations_identity_present.name: invitations_identity_present
invitations_identity_present.value: "staff"."invitations"."status" = 'open' or ("staff"."invitations"."email" is not null and "staff"."invitations"."full_name" is not null)

invitations_pending_shape.name: invitations_pending_shape
invitations_pending_shape.value: "staff"."invitations"."status" <> 'pending' or ("staff"."invitations"."submitted_at" is not null and (("staff"."invitations"."password_hash" is not null)::int + ("staff"."invitations"."account_id" is not null)::int) = 1)

invitations_approved_shape.name: invitations_approved_shape
invitations_approved_shape.value: "staff"."invitations"."status" <> 'approved' or ("staff"."invitations"."account_id" is not null and "staff"."invitations"."decided_by" is not null and "staff"."invitations"."decided_at" is not null)

invitations_rejected_shape.name: invitations_rejected_shape
invitations_rejected_shape.value: "staff"."invitations"."status" <> 'rejected' or ("staff"."invitations"."decided_by" is not null and "staff"."invitations"."decided_at" is not null)

invitations_decided_clean.name: invitations_decided_clean
invitations_decided_clean.value: "staff"."invitations"."status" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or ("staff"."invitations"."password_hash" is null and "staff"."invitations"."otp_hash" is null and "staff"."invitations"."totp_secret_enc" is null and cardinality("staff"."invitations"."recovery_code_hashes") = 0)

invitations_totp_confirmed_has_secret.name: invitations_totp_confirmed_has_secret
invitations_totp_confirmed_has_secret.value: "staff"."invitations"."totp_confirmed_at" is null or "staff"."invitations"."totp_secret_enc" is not null
